name: Ecchi na Maid-san wa Ojousama to Futanari
original_name: えっちなメイドさんはお嬢様とふたなり
source:
A man visits a mansion where owner lives with a dozens of maids.
He finds a maid getting abused by futanari maid...... What action will he take.....?

一名男子参观一栋宅邸，宅主与数十名女仆住在一起。
他发现女仆被扶他女仆虐待……他会采取什么行动……？
